title: Scoped negative result: R439 column 7 needs five taps under two fixed undo orders
body:
## Result and scope

Retained-total column 7 of the pinned PR1062 R439 word needs exactly **five scalar scatter ADDs** even when its taps may occur at every target and every cut of either of two fixed undo orders: the literal 306 gates, or the 303 deferred gates after PR2115's known `{31,51,52}` split.

The known 94-ADD split already uses five taps for this column. This contribution rules out improving that column to four taps in these two interleaving classes; **no new kappa or supplier adoption is claimed**. PR2279 proves the all-ideal split optimum and explicitly excludes scatter interleavings. This result adds distinct evidence in that excluded class; it does not prove a global interleaving optimum or cover arbitrary commuting orders, other columns, mixed copied totals, or new target gates.

## Exact evidence

- Complete suffix dictionaries: 415 / 412 distinct 111-bit responses over all 34,077 / 33,744 tap locations.
- Complete sums of at most two responses: 83,624 / 82,435 values. Their translated intersections are empty, excluding every sum of at most four taps. Five explicit taps attain the required response.
- A separately written checker reconstructs coefficients with forward set-valued matrix rows instead of backward columns, and executes both witnesses forwards. The two-plus-two coverage lemma is shared; this is algorithmic independence, not independent human review.
- Full local witness records pass all 661 dirty input columns in both directions, exact COPY/ERASE checks, ordered frame MOVEs, paid profiles and positive majorants. The ideal-order witness matches the known 11,067 total ADDs, with nine rank-seven copies, nine erasures, one temporary, rank mass 5,129 and 95/181 guard bits. Every undo gate remains charged.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-interleaved-scatter-seed16
```

Expected final marker: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`.

The registered CPython 3.12.13 replay passed locally: normal and optimized primary checks, independent reconstruction, 12 primary / 6 independent controls, and actual-entry-point Git-free read-only relocation and corruption checks. `git diff --cached --check` passes. No selected cold replay or hosted CI pass is claimed.

Native phase/parser admission of undo gates inside a live COPY, whole-call hosting, all-size/compiler realization, physical precision/tapes and outer assembly remain open or inherited. The finite coefficient result does not establish the full multiplication theorem.

The selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged.
